modules.name: Mobilisation and site establishment
modules.desc: Contractor mobilisation: site offices, laydown, temporary power and water, tool rooms and the safety set-up before the first work face opens.

modules.name: Equipment foundation (spread footing)
modules.desc: Reinforced spread footings and plinths for pumps, exchangers, vessels and pipe-rack bents: layout, excavation, forming, rebar, anchor bolts, inspection, pour, cure, strip and backfill.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Augercast piles
modules.desc: Augercast (CFA) piles: rig mobilisation, drill and grout, reinforcing cages, integrity testing and cut-off.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Concrete paving and slab on grade
modules.desc: Process area paving, curbs and slabs: subgrade preparation, base, forms, reinforcement, pour, finish, cure and saw-cut joints.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Underground piping and duct bank
modules.desc: Below-grade process / fire-water piping or electrical duct bank: excavate, bed, lay or form and encase, test, backfill and compact.

tasks.desc: Locate services and lay out trench

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Pipe rack erection
modules.desc: Shop-fabricated pipe rack: shake-out, columns, beams and struts by level, bracing, plumb and align, bolt-up and torque, grating and handrail, grout base plates.

tasks.desc: Bolt inspection and turnover to piping

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Platforms, ladders and stairs
modules.desc: Access steel on equipment and structures: frames, grating, handrail, stair towers and caged ladders.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Pre-engineered building
modules.desc: Pre-engineered metal building (compressor house, warehouse, MCC building): frames, girts and purlins, sheeting, doors and close-in.

tasks.desc: Check anchor bolts and set base plates

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Pump set, grout and align
modules.desc: Horizontal pumps on prepared foundations: receive, set, level and shim, grout, rough alignment, final alignment after piping and bump test.

tasks.desc: Pipe connections by the piping scope

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Vessel or column set
modules.desc: Vertical vessels and columns: lift plan, crane assembly, dressing at grade, lift and set with tailing, plumb and level, torque and grout, crane demobilisation.

queries.prompt: Dress at grade (platforms, ladders, insulation) before the lift?

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Heat exchanger set
modules.desc: Shell-and-tube exchangers on foundations or structure: rig and set, level, slide plates, anchor bolts and bundle-pull clearance check.

tasks.desc: Set stacked unit and bolt intermediate supports
Level, slide plates and anchor bolts

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Air-cooled exchanger set
modules.desc: Fin-fan air coolers on the rack or their own structure: structure, bundles, fans and drives, plenums and louvres, alignment.

tasks.desc: Align fans and set blade pitch

modules.author: VissRad

modules.desc: Skid-mounted compressor package: set, level, grout, auxiliary consoles, cold alignment and pre-commissioning support.

tasks.desc: Bottom plates: lay out, weld and vacuum test

modules.author: VissRad
